notes: Every flak value printed on the game map: one AA-point figure in each of the four off-map boxes at the west edge of map A (Tunis, Gabes, Tripoli, Tripolitania). Under 41.85 each is constant and indestructible; it is Axis flak and fires at missions flown against targets in its box. It spends ammunition like other flak (V-022 records the unlimited-ammunition house rule as a variant).
heavy: printed flak counts as heavy under R-111, so fighters cannot suppress it (40.74).

No map hex carries printed flak. The Malta inset prints facility capacities only; Malta's flak is noted off-map (44.18) and set by each scenario (`air.malta.aa_points`). The Egyptian off-map air-facility boxes on map E print distances only.

Read from the VASSAL redraw of the map (vassal:CNAv2.1.0), which intends no changes from the SPI map; no SPI map scan is in hand, so the four values await a check against a printed copy (docs/autopilot/decisions.json, printed-flak-boxes). One community database reads Tripoli as 26 rather than 25.
